result.summary: The page mostly renders correctly, but there are two visible issues: one restaurant card image appears to have failed to load, and the bottom navigation overlaps the next card so it looks cut off.

issues.description: In the "Popular right now" section, the restaurant card shows a generic broken-image placeholder instead of an actual photo.
issues.suggestion: Check the image URL/loading state and provide a fallback thumbnail or retry so the card displays a proper image.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card at the bottom of the screen is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar, making the content look clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add extra bottom padding to the scroll content or adjust the sticky nav spacing so cards are fully visible above it.
